Barbell_Guillotine_Bench_Press: Unrack the bar with a medium grip and hold it above your neck.
Lower slowly to about one inch above your neck.
Pause, then press back up using your chest.
Decline_Barbell_Bench_Press: Secure your legs and lie on the decline bench.
Unrack the bar with a medium grip; hold it above you.
Lower slowly to your lower chest.
Dumbbell_One-Arm_Shoulder_Press: Sit with back support or stand upright, holding one dumbbell.
Bring the dumbbell to shoulder height.
Narrow_Stance_Hack_Squats: Rest your back against the pad and shoulders under the supports.
Place feet close together, with toes slightly out.
Hold the handles and release the safety bars.
Narrow_Stance_Leg_Press: Sit with feet closer than shoulder-width and toes slightly out.
Release the safety bars and extend your legs without locking your knees.
Lower slowly until your knees reach about 90 degrees.
Seated_Barbell_Military_Press: Sit upright and take the bar with palms forward; use a spotter to help unrack.
Seated_One-arm_Cable_Pulley_Rows: Sit with feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Keep your back aligned; grasp the handle with your palm down.
Sit upright with your working arm extended.
Barbell_Ab_Rollout: Start in a push-up position, gripping a lightly loaded barbell instead of the floor.
Lift your hips and roll the bar toward your feet.
Pause, then slowly roll forward to the starting position.
Bent-Arm_Dumbbell_Pullover: Place a dumbbell securely on a flat bench.
Lie across the bench with only your shoulders supported.
Hold the dumbbell above your chest with both hands and bent elbows.
Bent_Over_Barbell_Row: Use an overhand grip. Bend your knees and hinge forward with a straight back.
Keep your torso still and pull the bar toward you.
Lower slowly to the starting position.
Bent_Over_Two-Dumbbell_Row: Hold the dumbbells, bend your knees, and hinge forward with a straight back.
Keep your torso still and row with elbows close to your body.
Bent_Over_Two-Dumbbell_Row_With_Palms_In: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other. Hinge forward with a straight back.
Keep your torso still; row and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Decline_Dumbbell_Flyes: Secure your legs and lie on the decline bench with dumbbells on your thighs.
Bring the dumbbells above you, shoulder-width apart.
Keep elbows slightly bent and lower your arms in a wide arc.
Bench_Dips: Place a bench behind you and grip its edge to support your body.
Bend your elbows and lower your body under control.
Press through your hands to return to the starting position.
Calf_Raise_On_A_Dumbbell: Hold a sturdy support for balance and place your foot on the dumbbell handle.
Roll your foot slightly forward to stretch your calf.
Raise your heel over the handle to contract your calf.
Seated_Close-Grip_Concentration_Barbell_: Sit on a bench with a barbell or EZ bar between your legs.
Grip the bar and brace your upper arms against your inner thighs, above the knees.
Keep upper arms still and curl the bar up.
Standing_Dumbbell_Calf_Raise: Stand upright with dumbbells at your sides.
Raise your heels by contracting your calves.
Cable_Wrist_Curl: Place a bench in front of a low pulley with a straight-bar attachment.
Grip palms up and rest your forearms on your thighs.
Curl your wrists upward as you exhale.
Flutter_Kicks: Lie facedown on a bench with hips at the edge; hold the bench for support.
Straighten your legs until they are level with your hips.
Lift the left leg above the right, then alternate.
Glute_Kickback: Start on hands and knees with hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your knee bent at 90 degrees and lift your leg until your thigh aligns with your back.
Lower with control, then repeat on the other side.
One-Legged_Cable_Kickback: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and secure it around your ankle.
Face the stack and hold the frame for support.
Brace your abs and extend your working leg back without forcing the range.
Seated_Two-Arm_Palms-Up_Low-Pulley_Wrist: Place a bench in front of a low pulley with a bar attachment.
Position the bench so the cable stays taut with your hands over your thighs.
Hold the bar with palms up and hands shoulder-width apart.
